title: rosa × paulii f. rosea
intro: Rosa × paulii f. rosea, commonly known as Paul's rose, is a hybrid species of rose that is a cross between Rosa gigantea and Rosa × fortuniana. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which have been utilized in traditional medicine to alleviate various health issues. The health benefits of Rosa × paulii f. rosea include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain, inflammation, and the risk of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
